svg.title: Pydantic AI Docs: read the current docs page on demand
svg.desc: The model calls read_pyai_docs with one of six topics. The tool first looks for the page in a docs checkout inside the run workspace, and otherwise fetches it from the main branch on GitHub. It then replaces model aliases using model_aliases/aliases.json and returns the full page to the model. If neither source has the page, the tool returns an error naming the path and URL it tried.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
